title: Upgrade genesis to v0.2.0 (config + guide modules)
description:
OpenSpec change: openspec/changes/upgrade-genesis (validated --strict).

Upgrade genesis from v0.1.0 to v0.2.0 and adopt the new config and guide modules.

This adds config management and CLI scaffolding on top of the existing genesis dependency (crua-cfj).

**Tasks:**

1. Bump genesis dependency to v0.2.0 in Cargo.toml.
2. Adopt genesis::config: add config struct with ConfigFile impl (when src/crua gains config); register with ConfigRegistry.
3. Adopt genesis::guide: when CLI is built, use Guide::builder(...) and Output<T>.
4. Cleanup: cargo test, clippy, fmt.

**Blocked by:** genesis v0.2.0 tagged (already done).
**Coordinates with:** crua-cfj (depend on genesis core).

title: Reconcile hotness-to-livin output contract with livin EARS spec
description:
Finding C2 from the charly suite consistency evaluation.

crua-ears-spec.md Section 1 states: 'a coverage checker called Livin can consume Crua hotness data in return, if either is present.' crua also lists a Shape source of 'vampiro' and an Effect channel consumed from Vampiro, and produces hotness classes.

However livin-ears-spec.md Section 1 lists ONLY Vampiro as a shape source, and livin's 'Shape source' field references only vampiro. livin's spec never acknowledges crua's hotness feed.

So crua advertises an output contract that livin's normative spec does not reference — a traceability break between the two normative specs.

Acceptance criteria:
- Decide whether the crua->livin hotness feed is real or aspirational.
- If real: add a 'hotness source: crua' input + corresponding REQ to livin-ears-spec.md, and add an explicit output REQ here in crua-ears-spec.md naming livin as consumer with the data contract (format, path, schema).
- If aspirational: remove the claim from crua-ears-spec.md.
- Update both REQ IDs traceably; cross-link the two specs by REQ id.
- Verify with openspec validate --strict that the change traces.

title: Depend on genesis (build on genesis from day one)
description:
OpenSpec change: openspec/changes/depend-on-genesis (validated --strict).

crua is spec-stage with no src/ yet — build on genesis from day one rather than reimplement CLI/AIX/self-healing infra and port later. Composes with crua's existing add-rust-cli-foundation change (does NOT replace it).

Scope: add genesis git dep (tag v0.1.0); source JSON envelope from genesis::envelope (crua cli-foundation 'Shared finding contract' maps findings under data); source self-healing errors from genesis::suggestions (cli-foundation 'Stable exit categories' gains the Suggestion footer); source managed-block injector from genesis::managed_block (so crua carries WAI/OPENSPEC/DONT blocks, detectable by wai status = wai-bdqw.9); ship llms.txt/llm.txt via genesis::aix when stable. Keep all crua domain logic (cost-pattern catalogue, hotness classes, tree-sitter front ends, benchmark generation).

Spec delta: cli-foundation (MODIFIED Shared finding contract + Stable exit categories -> sourced from genesis).

Blocked by: genesis tagging v0.1.0.
Coordinates with: crua EARS spec (crua-ears-spec.md) — no REQ changes there; this is CLI infrastructure.
Coordinates with: vampiro add-rust-cli-foundation design.md 'Deferred: tree-sitter front-end and CIR extraction' — crua consumes vampiro's CIR via --json, not by linking vampiro's crate (tool-craft 7 boundary rule).

Tasks: openspec/changes/depend-on-genesis/tasks.md (5 sections: dependency, source envelope, source suggestions, source managed_block, AIX artifacts).

Acceptance: crua check --json top-level keys match shared shape (findings under data); unknown crua subcommand emits 'Did you mean ...?' via genesis::suggestions (no local Suggestion enum); crua carries WAI/OPENSPEC/DONT managed blocks.
notes: ALIGN-002 coordinates with crua-ears-spec.md (no REQ changes — CLI infrastructure only). Unblock signal: git ls-remote --tags https://github.com/charly-vibes/genesis v0.1.0. Verify: openspec validate depend-on-genesis --strict; crua check --json shared-shape keys (findings under data); unknown crua subcommand -> 'Did you mean ...?' via genesis::suggestions.
